# Outsourced Administrative Services, LLC

> Remote executive administrative support for small businesses nationwide, from Kern and Sacramento County, California, backed by 47 years of C-suite experience.

Owned and operated by Paula Daoutis, a career executive assistant and former executive director. Deliberately focused on board support, executive office coverage, and clearly scoped special projects — no account managers, no handoffs.

## Services

- [Services](https://oas-llc.com/services): Executive and C-suite administrative support, Board & CEO/Executive Director support, special and short-term projects, calendar and travel management, document preparation, and vendor and contract administration.
- [Kern County, CA](https://oas-llc.com/kern-county-ca): Fully remote administrative support for Bakersfield, Delano, Tehachapi, Ridgecrest and surrounding Kern County communities, with a local phone number.
- [Sacramento County, CA](https://oas-llc.com/sacramento-county-ca): Board, association, and executive office support for the capital region, including legislative advocacy appearances at the State Capitol and executive travel arrangements.
